transient_executor_isolation.summary: Nested workspace-write sandbox caused sandbox-exec and LaunchServices/XPC failures; direct host reruns passed without source or test changes.

review_fixes: Accept a leading UTF-8 BOM while preserving subsequent source offsets.
Clamp caller-provided input, node, per-element attribute, total attribute, and text limits to documented hard ceilings.
Assert exact QName prefix and local-name source bytes.
Reject adjacent attributes without XML whitespace and reject QName local parts that do not begin with a NameStart character.
Validate source, name, value, prefix, and local-name spans in every successful deterministic malformed-generator case.
Confine resolved fuzz-report outputs to repository .cache/ or this work order’s artifacts directory, with regression tests for traversal and absolute paths.

Parse processing-instruction targets as XML Names, exclude the separator from PI data spans, and record the full non-empty start-tag span. Split UTF-8/XML character helpers into their own internal source module.
